summary:
Alembic Main rootcause6 rework1, based only on clean Alembic@8d9eea3 with exact accepted Core@96655b9 and Agent@3c95549. Preserve the predecessor's correct complete population/execution denominator, analysis/fixpoint lineage, private revision context, expression-set closure, G3/G4, physical/public lineage and CAS changes. Repair the controller-proven authority defect: StrictPrivateCorpusRuntime currently fabricates pass KnowledgeDispositionReview receipts for five live merge outcomes without invoking the independent reviewer, and StrictFinalizationRuntime does the same for investigated-empty; the integration fixture hand-builds review receipts and only proves that at least one unrelated G2 review occurred.

Use the existing AgentService and Agent/Core public evaluation/production contracts. For every producer non-draft merge/duplicate terminal and every investigated-empty decision, execute the configured independent reviewer through the real host boundary, require success with no tools, parse a typed verdict and reason/evidence output, then form the Core receipt from the actual producer/reviewer provider, model, prompt, run, invocation, load and response-output hashes. Main may validate and persist the receipt but must never declare verdict=pass or synthesize a reviewer output hash from admission/ready-member structures. Missing, malformed, stale, rebound, reused, non-pass or tool-calling review must fail closed before HypothesisExpressionSet closure/G3.

Refactor the deterministic fixture so it returns reviewer responses at the LLM/external boundary rather than constructing the authority receipt for the seam under test. Track exact reviewer invocation records and assert five distinct merge reviews plus the existing G2 review in the positive Facade run; prove each terminal receipt binds the matching actual response hash and current schedule/fixpoint/execution denominator. Add negative probes for the old shortcut and authority rebindings. Add a positive all-inspected-no-pattern investigated-empty closure only if current accepted Core/Agent contracts can produce it without changing sibling repositories; otherwise return the exact producer-contract blocker rather than fabricating it. Regenerate fresh-process checkpoint/runtime evidence and replace the inaccurate 'independently receipt-backed' claim with raw invocation/receipt conservation evidence. Main-only, no new platform and no Test.
sourceRef: Original Plan and Requirement Design §§11.6-12.2,18.3,21; controller rework decision evt-20260727131445-0234; predecessor commit 8d9eea3 and preserved checkpoint/report evidence
designIntent: 在 Alembic 现有 strict AgentService、IndependentValueReviewer、private persistence、coverage/finalizer 与 journal 链内，让每个语义终态使用真实独立 reviewer 执行产生的 authority；Main 只编排、校验和持久化，不自行签发 reviewer verdict，也不新增第二评审平台。

required.verify: One clean Alembic repair commit based exactly on 8d9eea3dda77cd4de7c33327cb66493e347b34ff; exact local AlembicCore 96655b9bbd56f22381ffa7f48a6cd52cabc5a1da and AlembicAgent 3c95549bb82aa011216d6d3be0f41741ba42d5ad; report parent/commit/tree and changed files.
Run build:check, focused strict Facade/private-corpus/finalization/reviewer tests, full npm run check, npm run build, repository/Core/Agent/layer/ring/shared-asset gates, and git diff --check.

Fresh-process Main Facade proof must show one content-ready row and every merge/duplicate row has a distinct actual reviewer invocation/load/output identity from the real AgentService boundary; receipt output hashes equal reviewed response hashes, invocation counts are conserved, and the accepted chain still reaches expression closure, G3/G4, serving manifest and public CAS.

Missing, malformed, tool-calling, stale, rebound, duplicate/reused, non-pass or output-hash-mismatched producer-non-draft and investigated-empty reviewer results fail closed before terminal closure/G3; tests must detect the old direct createKnowledgeDispositionReviewV1 pass construction and per-run boolean-only false green.

Only Alembic source/tests and its task evidence change; no Core/Agent/Plugin/Dashboard/Design/Test/Wakeflow/vendor/cache edits, no real LLM/daemon reset/Ghost-data mutation, and no new reviewer/proof platform.

targetTasks.summary: Replace Main-synthesized merge/duplicate and investigated-empty reviewer receipts with actual independent AgentService executions, prove per-terminal invocation/output lineage, and preserve all accepted rootcause6 downstream lineage work.
